name: TSForecasting (Monash Time Series Forecasting Archive)
what_it_holds: Code/experiment framework (R) for the Monash Time Series Forecasting Archive: loaders for `.tsf` files, forecasting model implementations, evaluation scripts. Datasets themselves are not committed in-repo but pulled one-command from the Zenodo community at zenodo.org/communities/forecasting (which includes the Tourism yearly/quarterly/monthly sets above, plus dozens of other domains: electricity, tourism, traffic, weather, etc.).
why_useful: Gives a ready-made, citable evaluation harness (train/test splits, standard error metrics) for benchmarking any of our own nowcasting methods against a large, standardized multi-domain time-series archive — useful for the point-in-time / backtesting discipline the project already enforces (gap #17), and as a one-command puller for the tourism .tsf files rather than hand-downloading Zenodo zips.
